npcs.name: Banner-Reeve Torbjorn
npcs.greet: Wagons from the southern steam-flats are backed up at the bridge—Windhelm's war-chest levy has locked the docks and the Gray Quarter merchants are on strike.

npcs.name: Factor Ambarys
npcs.greet: The Palace demands double provisioning while privateers strip our coastal barges and blame the Argonians on the ice-wharf.

npcs.name: Foreman Verner
npcs.greet: Raiders out of Lost Knife and Mistwatch have been seizing the corundum shipments before they ever reach the river road.

eastmarch_palace_accord: Factor Ambarys: The recovered East Empire cargo manifests and the Mzulft boiler-cores leave the dock-wardens with no excuse to bar the quarters.
Banner-Reeve Torbjorn: With the southern mines open and the wharf wages settled, Windhelm's supply lines are secure.
Factor Ambarys: Stamp the new charter in the Palace of the Kings—every quarter of the city stands on the rolls.

stages.objective: Hear the banner-reeve's briefing at Kynesgrove on the seized supply wagons.
Recover the impounded shipping tallies from the raiders in Stony Creek Cave.
Deliver the shipping tallies to the quarter factor in Windhelm.
Inspect the disputed dock-wage rolls with the wharf stevedores and Gray Quarter elders.
Trace the smuggled customs chest to the border tower at Refugees' Rest.
Reclaim the stolen guild seal hidden in the sea-cliff vestibule of Yngol Barrow.
Take the mine foreman's statement at Darkwater Crossing.
Break the highwaymen's toll-camp inside Lost Knife Hideout.
Free the captive teamsters held in the eastern keep of Mistwatch.
Secure the southern signal-cairn overlooking the flats at Bonestrewn Crest.
Recover the Dwemer steam-regulators from the lower observatory of Mzulft.
Ratify the Three-Quarter Supply Charter in the Palace of the Kings at Windhelm.
